classification.difficultyReason: Identify y=2x as the suitable line, draw it on the supplied cubic graph, then interpret the intersections as x-values within the stated interval and estimate them to 2 d.p. These are routine linked graphical procedures with the solution approach explicitly signposted.

content.prompt:
The diagram shows the graph of $y=x^3+4x^2-2$ for $-3\leq x\leq1.5$.

By drawing a suitable straight line, solve the equation $x^3+4x^2-2=2x$ for $-3\leq x\leq1.5$.

Give your answer as estimates to 2 d.p.

spec.description: Portrait Cartesian graph with fine dotted grid, half-unit x labels, unit y labels and the supplied cubic. No solution line is visible.
spec.mathematics: y=x^3+4x^2-2; -3<=x<=1.5; -3<=y<=8. Minor grid steps are 0.1 in both coordinate directions; major grid steps are 0.5 horizontally and 1 vertically.
spec.answerVisibility: Supplied cubic and grid are permanent student givens; the straight line and intersection estimates are withheld.

answer.worked:
Draw the straight line $y=2x$ on the supplied axes.

Read the $x$-coordinates of its intersections with $y=x^3+4x^2-2$ in the stated interval:

$$x\approx-0.52\quad\text{and}\quad x\approx0.88.$$

spec.description: Complete supplied coordinate frame and cubic with the added line y=2x and both in-domain intersections marked.
spec.mathematics: Intersections in -3<=x<=1.5 have x approximately -0.523548 and 0.877404, giving -0.52 and 0.88 to two decimal places.
